//: Deploy-ISOLATED config for shipping the apps/functions (codebase `storage`) Cloud Functions to a real Firebase project. It contains ONLY the `functions` block — deliberately NO `firestore`/`storage`/`emulators` keys — so a `firebase deploy` with this config can never push the Flutter-owned firestore.rules/storage.rules over live (CLAUDE.md critical rule #1). Companion configs: firebase.json (prod firestore rules), firebase.staging.json (staging firestore.e2e.rules), firebase.functions.json (emulator suite only), firebase.rules.json (rules emulator). Deploy: see apps/functions/DEPLOY.md. The bundle inlines FUNCTIONS_REGION at build time (build.mjs), so you MUST build before deploying.
